resume.name: Mehdi Bennouna
resume.bio: Software engineer with a broad background across web applications, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure. Focused on clean architecture, automation, and shipping reliable software.

description: Built backend APIs (Express, Fastify, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) for a platform serving thousands of active users, including a payment engine with a fully auditable balance ledger and real-time features over WebSockets and Redis.
Shipped user-facing, backoffice and admin web apps (Next.js, React, TanStack), and used Playwright for workflow automation, scraping and QA testing.
Owned the infrastructure: background jobs (BullMQ), SSO (Zitadel), automated deployments and secrets (Docker, Ansible, GitLab CI, Vault), and observability (Grafana, OpenTelemetry).

Built backend services for a ride-hailing platform of five apps serving 25k drivers. Engineered rider-driver matching and live tracking (Redis Geo, Mapbox, Google Maps), with realtime sync across distributed servers (Socket.IO, Redis pub/sub).
Developed payments for digital and cash rides on top of a double-entry ledger, and implemented regulatory compliance for data retention, driver verification and record-keeping.

Designed an event-driven architecture for multi-channel notifications, set up observability across the stack, and built internal tools (ledger viewer, queue inspector, driver simulator) that sped up debugging and testing.

Delivered APIs, business websites and full-stack apps for local and international clients. Highlights include the Nusuk.sa website (Next.js, Express), an Electron-based touchscreen kiosk app for live events, and the frontend for META-Z, a Web3 metaverse game integrating MetaMask and Web3.js.

Delivered a comprehensive 6-month MERN stack curriculum (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, MongoDB) to three distinct student cohorts, guiding them through end-to-end capstone projects to ensure technical readiness for school-arranged internships.

Taught in-person courses on Python fundamentals and full-stack web development (HTML, CSS, JS, React, Node.js, MongoDB), and mentored students through their capstone projects to prepare them for school-arranged internships.
